guideImpact.reason: The reviewed behaviour exposes a Show linked sites control in a Surveyor layer's Display Settings and preserves the changed state when the dialog is reopened. Users need guidance on where to find and use this setting.

guideUpdate.title: Manage linked-site visibility in a Surveyor layer
guideUpdate.affectedSection: GIS Display Settings: Show linked sites
steps: Open Display Settings for a loaded Surveyor layer.
Select Show linked sites to check or uncheck it.
Close Display Settings to keep the Surveyor layer and its legend available.
Reopen Display Settings to see the selected Show linked sites state retained.
screenshotCaptions: Display Settings shows Show linked sites checked for the loaded Surveyor layer.
After Display Settings is closed, Surveyor - Service remains in Map layers with its expanded legend.
After reopening Display Settings for the same layer, Show linked sites remains unchecked.
guideUpdate.reason: Amend the Surveyor layer Display Settings guidance to explain changing Show linked sites while retaining the layer and legend and preserving the selected state when settings are reopened.
